extension.news: 2.0 : - Builds on 1.1.1Beta1. - Renamed: installs as "Language Preference Manager NeXt" (id service.languagepreferencemanagernext), next to the original. The settings changed in the original and its stored preferences are taken over once; when the original is installed and enabled as well, the add-on asks once whether to turn it off. - New: two regex subtitle filter profiles - "Anime & forced foreign subtitles" (as before) and "Anime & foreign subtitles, not forced" (no "forced" in the pattern); each has its own list of additional words (comma separated, whole words only or anywhere in the name) that is used in addition to the built-in pattern, which is not changed. - Fix: the settings dump shows what a spinner stands for and the order of the subtitle formats; all settings are written once per playback, a changed setting is written on its own. - Removed: the Audio Preferences and Subtitle Preferences tabs; General, Conditional Subtitle Preferences (the rules, which can also choose the audio) and Overrides remain. - Regional/script language variants (English UK/US/Australia/India/Canada, Spanish Spain/Latin America, French France/Canada/Belgium/Switzerland, Portuguese Portugal/Brazil, Chinese Simplified/Traditional, German Switzerland/Austria, Dutch Belgium) share one engine; the region is read from the track tag, title or external subtitle file name. - New "Sub converter": ASS/SSA and other text subtitles keep their styles, only bottom lines move to the top. - New: subtitle format preference (issue #30): rank SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, PGS and VobSub in General settings; among subtitles that fit your language preference equally well, the first format of your list that is present is used. - Reworked seekback / "Fast Subtitles Display" ("Start & Resume" by default). - Regex subtitle filter fixes; external subtitle languages read from file names; safer stored preferences. - The settings values of the 1.1.1Beta1 language variants were renumbered: re-select regional languages in settings. - New: each conditional subtitle rule can use its own preferred subtitle format (general order, or the 1st / 2nd / 3rd format of the General settings); custom rules: -f1 / -f2 / -f3. - Fix: the sub converter also runs when subtitles are switched by hand during the playback, and converts embedded SRT as well. - Fix: subtitle format preference with external subtitle files of the same language (Movie.en.ass + Movie.en.srt): a preferred ASS is no longer passed over for an embedded PGS (.sup). - New: protection against a stale copy: no compiled Python files are used, the log shows the running version and code, and a warning is shown when another copy of the add-on is installed. Settings, General, Installation: "Check installation" says whether the installation is clean. - Fixed: with a subtitle format preference set, a text track (ASS/SRT/WebVTT) that only has the forced/default flag (no "forced" in its name) is no longer excluded from non-forced rules, so the format preference can choose it (e.g. English ASS flagged forced+default with Japanese audio). Flagged image tracks (PGS/VobSub) and tracks named "forced" stay excluded; the unflagged track wins a tie within the same format; without a format preference nothing changes. - Changed: the regex subtitle filter now respects the preferred subtitle language and format. Among the tracks the regex matches, it takes the language of the conditional rule for the playing audio, then the best format (the rule's 1st/2nd/3rd choice or the general order); the forced/default/original flags and "forced" names do not count there. If no matching track is in a preferred language, the filter works as before (ASS first, forced tracks deferred). 1.1.1Beta1 : - Add regional/script language preferences for English, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese, grouped with their base language in settings (Thanks to Hugs11). - Prefer exact BCP-47 tags or recognized track-title variants, then unlabelled tracks of the same language; preserve generic language preferences (Thanks to Hugs11). - Add Chinese translation (Thanks to wabisabi926). - Avoid some wrong seekback decisions in subtitles delayed workaround.

extension.summary: Skip intro, recap, credits and preview segments from online databases, theme songs and the sound of the episodes
extension.description: Looks up segment times at TheIntroDB and IntroDB, finds anime openings and endings by comparing the episode's sound with the theme song from AnimeThemes, reads chapters, and compares episodes of the same show. Only fingerprints are kept (fingerprint.db); the sound is never saved. Other add-ons can ask it for the segments of an episode.
extension.news: v0.1.16 - "Show what fingerprint.db holds" now opens a list of every show, its episodes, fingerprints and found segments, and the themes. v0.1.15 - Music and other background audio no longer start or reset the skip logic, and movies are ignored (episodes only: episode info or SxxEyy in the name; the "any long video" fallback is gone). Requests from other add-ons are ignored unless they are for an episode. v0.1.14 - New setting: end offset when NO end was found (credits / preview that run to the end of the video, counted from 10 s before the end). The end and credits end offsets now apply only to ends that were found. v0.1.13 - Fix: the end offsets (general and credits / outro) now also move the skip target of a credits or preview segment that has no end time of its own (it runs to the end of the video), which is when the log said the target was always 10 s before the end. v0.1.12 - Fix: offsets are now applied every time segments are read, so changing them works for episodes already looked up (before, the old offsets stayed baked in until the add-on restarted). v0.1.11 - New settings: separate start and end offsets for credits / outro segments (added on top of the general offsets). v0.1.10 - New settings: unselected button outline (faint / normal / strong) and card backdrop (transparent / light / dark). v0.1.9 - Skip buttons and cards now use the NightShift look: transparent, thin outline, neon border on the selected button (pill and card styles, 1080i and 720p). v0.1.8 - One zip for every device (64-bit ARM, 32-bit ARM, x86-64); on first start the add-on keeps the library of the device it runs on and deletes the others. v0.1.7 - The skip button hides after 12 s by default (never stays longer than 30 s). v0.1.6 - The card prefers the show fanart, then the thumbnail. v0.1.5 - The card shows the thumbnail and episode line the player supplies. v0.1.4 - The card style now copies the NightShift skip prompt (dimmed top, thumbnail, heading, episode line, round buttons) for every segment kind. v0.1.3 - Test popup works (settings action), visible button textures, card style with thumbnail, the skip button closes when another video starts, the extra skip-past-end seconds setting is gone (offsets replace it).

extension.summary: Play Usenet NZBs: availability check, native reader, local HTTPS fallback
extension.description: Shared Usenet streaming for Kodi add-ons. Other add-ons call nntpstream.check(nzb, servers) to find out whether a release is complete (STAT, no download) and nntpstream.play_url(nzb, servers) to get a playable URL. With vfs.nntp installed the film is read natively on all cores (nntpstream://); without it a plain-HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 is used (no certificate or key is shipped). Your own certificates: put .pem files in userdata/addon_data/service.nntp.stream/certs.
extension.news: 0.2.3 - the unpacked file name no longer keeps commas and similar characters (a comma split the PlayMedia arguments, so the file was not opened). 0.2.2 - releases with obfuscated or unquoted file names are now recognised (the real names are read from the first article of each big file); ZIP releases are recognised as packed; the "no video file" message lists the biggest files. 0.2.1 - unpacking now reads the whole release as ONE long file through vfs.nntp (rapidyenc decoder, connections shared by speed) when it is installed; the Python downloader is the fallback. 0.2.0 - new: unpack_to() downloads a packed release (stored RAR 2-5 / ZIP, multi-volume) and unpacks its video into a folder, so it plays from disk with no debrid service. 0.1.1 - fixes: the service no longer hangs when Kodi stops or updates it (it polled the GUI, which deadlocked), the empty servers setting no longer errors, the add-on shows under Program add-ons (opens its settings) as well as Services, and the fallback uses the running service for its local server. 0.1.0 - first version: STAT availability check, plan writer, Python fallback (HTTPS on 127.0.0.1), native vfs.nntp support.
